name: read
description: Read a text file. Returns lines as `N|content` plus a `[lines A-B of TOTAL]` footer. At most 2000 lines or 50K chars per call; use offset/limit to page through large files instead of re-reading them whole. Lines longer than 2000 chars are truncated. Binary files are refused. A file must be read before write/edit may change it.

path.description: File path, relative to the workdir or absolute

name: ls
description: List one directory level, sorted. Directories end with `/`, symlinks with `@`. Hidden entries only with hidden=true. Use search to find files recursively.
